title: LEGO Now Makes More Profit Than It Used to Sell
sentence: In 2004 LEGO had DKK 6.3 billion of revenue and lost DKK 1.8 billion; in 2025 it had DKK 83.5 billion of revenue, 13 times more, and a DKK 16.7 billion net profit.
source: The LEGO Group, Annual Report 2025 and results release (March 10, 2026): https://www.lego.com/en-us/aboutus/news/2026/march/the-lego-group-delivers-record-results-in-2025-driven-by-strong-brand-and-innovative-portfolio
The LEGO Group, Annual Report 2008 (five-year highlights 2004-2008): https://www.lego.com/cdn/cs/aboutus/assets/blt9ac392a2506c758a/Annual_Report_2008_ENG.pdf
